matter.description: Fictional demonstration of medical charges, payments, adjustments, and unresolved balances. Every person, provider, record, and amount is invented.

sources.title: Fictional financial demonstration — provenance and scope
sources.text: This is a fictional demonstration. Every person, provider, statement, payment, and amount in this matter is invented. The records describe cumulative medical billing snapshots as of the date on each source. A later snapshot from the same provider replaces the earlier snapshot; the snapshots are not separate bills to add together. Patient responsibility means the remaining amount explicitly assigned to the patient in the statement. An insurance denial does not by itself establish what the patient owes. Unknown means the amount has not been established in these demonstration records. No real balances, financial accounts, or insurance systems are connected.

sources.title: Maple Example Hospital — prior medical billing snapshot
sources.text:
Provider: Maple Example Hospital
Billed: $18,640.25
Insurance paid: $12,340.10
Patient paid: $500.00
Adjustments: $4,500.15
Outstanding balance: $1,300.00
Patient responsibility: $800.00
Insurance pending: $500.00
Insurance denied: $0.00
Status: pending
Fictional cumulative statement. The insurer has not yet posted the final $500.00 payment. The patient balance already confirmed by the statement is $800.00. This statement is superseded by the October 1 snapshot.
sources.locator: Fictional demo · hospital statement dated September 15, 2026

sources.title: Maple Example Hospital — confirmed medical billing snapshot
sources.text:
Provider: Maple Example Hospital
Billed: $18,640.25
Insurance paid: $12,840.10
Patient paid: $500.00
Adjustments: $4,500.15
Outstanding balance: $800.00
Patient responsibility: $800.00
Insurance pending: $0.00
Insurance denied: $0.00
Status: confirmed
Fictional cumulative statement. All insurer payments and contractual adjustments shown above have posted. The remaining $800.00 is confirmed as the patient responsibility. This snapshot replaces the September 15 statement; do not add the two snapshots together.
sources.locator: Fictional demo · hospital statement dated October 1, 2026

sources.title: Cedar Example Orthopedics — insurance review in progress
sources.text:
Provider: Cedar Example Orthopedics
Billed: $12,450.00
Insurance paid: $6,200.00
Patient paid: $300.00
Adjustments: $1,950.00
Outstanding balance: $4,000.00
Patient responsibility: $500.00
Insurance pending: $2,500.00
Insurance denied: $1,000.00
Status: pending
Fictional cumulative statement. Payments and adjustments have posted. Of the outstanding balance, $500.00 is the confirmed remaining patient responsibility and $2,500.00 is awaiting the insurer's first decision. The separate $1,000.00 denied amount is under appeal, with responsibility unresolved. It is not included in the confirmed patient responsibility, and it is not also counted in insurance pending. The appeal outcome is unknown.
sources.locator: Fictional demo · orthopedic statement and insurer summary dated October 1, 2026

sources.title: Willow Example Physical Therapy — balance disputed
sources.text:
Provider: Willow Example Physical Therapy
Billed: $3,750.00
Insurance paid: $1,800.00
Patient paid: $150.00
Adjustments: $300.00
Outstanding balance: $1,500.00
Patient responsibility: Unknown
Insurance pending: $0.00
Insurance denied: $1,200.00
Status: disputed
Fictional cumulative statement. The provider reports a $1,500.00 balance. A $1,200.00 insurer denial is under dispute and the remaining $300.00 has not been allocated between patient responsibility and further adjustment. No remaining patient amount is confirmed. The reported balance is not a final patient bill. The denied amount is a subset of the reported outstanding balance, not an additional charge.
sources.locator: Fictional demo · physical therapy account summary dated September 30, 2026
